title: This is a nice utensil tray
text: This is a nice utensil tray. This is a nice utensil tray.  I love that the sides extend and you can put in larger items.  Be aware that you need a wide drawers if you want to spread out the sides for additional storage.  It's already a decent size, and it's even wider once expanded.  If you have a wide drawers, you will love this tray!
